text:
Lena (People Ops): Flagging a bug: today nightly import truncated some manager rating changes for ~12 reviews in the engineering org. We need a safe, auditable restore flow. cc @Maya (HR Compliance)
Arjun (Eng Manager): I noticed my teams ratings were lower than what I submitted. I still have my original export CSV with timestamps. Is it safe to reapply?
Maya (HR Compliance): We can restore but must preserve an immutable audit trail and require manager attestation for each row. No manual edits in the UI until People Ops runs the restore.
Dev (IC): This worries me  could this affect promotion windows?
Lena (People Ops): Short plan: 1) Managers prepare a signed CSV with columns `manager_email,reviewee_email,form_id,original_rating,submitted_rating,attested_by,attestation_ts,justification,source_export_url` 2) Send to people-ops@redwood.ai 3) People Ops will run a scoped `rating-restore` job that:   - validates idempotency against previous restores   - applies the original_rating as an immutable corrective event   - emits audit IDs like REST-#### for each row   - flags restored items in the calibration appendix and notifies chairs
Arjun (Eng Manager): Example header please so formats don't break the job.
Lena (People Ops): Example row (paste into file named rating_restore.csv):
```
manager_email,reviewee_email,form_id,original_rating,submitted_rating,attested_by,attestation_ts,justification,source_export_url
arjun@redwood.ai,dev@redwood.ai,form_99102,4.0,3.0,Arjun,2026-07-02T18:10:00Z,import truncated change,https://files.redwood.ai/exports/99102-2026-07-02.csv
```
Maya (HR Compliance): Compliance notes: - Each row must include a manager attestation (attested_by matches manager_email) - Attach supporting export or screenshot via `source_export_url` - We'll sample restore events for audit and may request additional proof.
Lena (People Ops): Operational notes: - Send CSV to people-ops@redwood.ai with subject `RATING_RESTORE_<team>` - SLA: we'll validate within 4 hours and run restores in batch windows (next 6 hours) - Job is idempotent and will return a small mapping CSV: input_row -> REST-#### id - DO NOT make manual changes in the UI to the affected forms until you receive REST IDs
review-sys-bot: System notice: nightly import job failed at 2026-07-03T03:12:17Z for dataset `manager_ratings_v2`. Failure cause: partial write. People Ops remediation recommended.
Arjun (Eng Manager): Sending CSV now for 3 affected reviews. Also adding the source export URLs.
Lena (People Ops): Received. Running validation now. If we spot mismatches we'll ping you for further attestation.
Lena (People Ops): Validation complete  3 rows validate. Starting restore job.
Lena (People Ops): Restore complete  applied 3 rows. Audit IDs: REST-7101, REST-7102, REST-7103. Appended `restores_july_2026.csv` to calibration packet. Chairs notified by email with instructions to treat restored rows as "corrected ratings"; promotion-impact flagged where relevant.
Maya (HR Compliance): We'll include REST- IDs in our audit sample and confirm promotions logic accounted for corrected ratings. Managers: retain your supporting exports for 180 days.
Dev (IC): I can see the corrected rating and the REST ID in my form. Thanks for the quick fix.
Arjun (Eng Manager): Closing loop  please add the CSV header and process notes to the review ops doc so managers can follow next cycle. Also filing a small ticket to add a UI banner when nightly import succeeds/fails.
Lena (People Ops): Will do. Posting the how-to and template now. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
